identity.title: [v0.92][ADR] Author and review the milestone architecture decision record set

values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Mechanically validate candidate numbering, Proposed/Deferred status, required sections, exact index parity, repository-path existence, accepted-file non-mutation, named deferrals, and standardized non-claims. Semantic evidence attribution and architecture correctness remain the independent review lane's responsibility.
Reject malformed documentation changes across the exact issue delta.
Fresh exact-head architecture, security-boundary, documentation, evidence-attribution, positive and fail-closed proof fidelity, and unsupported-claim review of every candidate disposition.
lanes.defer_reason: Runs only after the complete candidate packet and deterministic validation are current.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on number collision, missing required section, broken or non-repository evidence, unsupported architectural claim, accidental Accepted status, production cross-polis claim, unresolved review finding, or stale revision.
